FITPASS:

Live with : ABHI, CARE and ICICI Lombard

Benefits : 3 month Fitpass pro membership.
Maximum 3 gym sessions per week, maximum once per day. 

Where can the benefit be availed:FITPASS application only

How to avail the benefit:

1. 3 days after the policy where the benefit is activated is issued, an auto triggered email is sent to the customer's registered email ID which explains the benefit. 
2. The email has CTA which redirects to the FITPASS application
3. Customer needs to login with the registered mobile number
4. Benefit will be auto activated


Validity: 3 months from the policy issuance date irrespective of the login date. 

For any queries where activation is not done, pls reach out to your Respected Supervisor.

Q: What is the tenure of OPD coverage—does it apply for 1 year?
A: Yes, it applies for one year from the policy issuance date.


Q: Why does the PDF mention a flat 50% discount while the app only shows up to 20% discount for the same benefit?
A: Please share a screenshot for reference as per the process applied flat 50%.


Q: How many members under the policy are eligible to avail these benefits?
A. Fitpass only for the proposer / OPD - In discussion for dependents, kindly reach out to your supervisors, they will assist further


Q: What is the TAT (turnaround time) for receiving a response on the sheet?
A: Within 2 days.
